submitted.rationale: EQE rose steadily with Fe content: 0.005% at Fe0.52, 0.040% at Fe0.76 and 0.108% at Fe0.84. That fits hematite-like Fe-rich oxide being the active absorber at 2.7 eV, with Sb-rich or FeSbO4-rich films performing worse. Index 0 is the most Fe-rich candidate and gave the highest measured EQE.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.005%, about 20x lower. The near-1:1 FeSbO4 region is poor.
Not measured. EQE fell as Sb increased, so these are extrapolated to be worse.
